skill_availability_goal: Measure whether docs-audit separates content verification from the confirmed durable-result credential when commit objects have different availability.
prompt: 对 `.eval/release-context.md` 指向的 `v1.2.0` 发布证据执行 post-tag 文档审计。分别评估 direct-handoff 与 fresh-clone 两个场景，给出每个场景的结论、决定性证据、持久化边界和下一步。fixture 只读，不执行真实 tag、branch 或 release 写入。
